decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of planning permission P/2017/0890 approved 17/09/2018.Reason: To accord with the provisions of Section 92 (1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (RAVENSCROFT - LP1, 12916-20, 12916 � 21, 12916 � 22, 12916 � 23, 12916 � 24, 12916 � 25, Noise Assessment by Sharps Redmore Acoustic Consultants. Received: 22/12/2025 and those approved by P/2018/3696 Unnumbered Location Plan; 12916-20; 12916-21. Received 02/03/2017, Technical Note; Stage 1 Road Safety Audit. Received 18/05/2017, 12916-24C. Received 22/08/2017, Third Technical Note. Received 24/08/2017, Fourth Technical Note; 16073-01-103B. Received 13/11/2017, Planning, Design and Access Statement. Received 18/12/2017, 17063-00-109. Received 05/02/2018, 12916-25B. Received 27/03/2018, 12916-22-1H; 12916-22K; 12916-23G. Received 12/04/2018, 12916-64E. Received 16/07/2018) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - Before the development hereby permitted commences: a. A contaminated land Phase 1 desk study report shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Should the Phase 1 report recommend that a Phase 2 site investigation is required, then this shall be carried out and submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The site shall be investigated by a competent person to identify the extent and nature of contamination. The report should include a tiered risk assessment of the contamination based on the proposed end use of the site. Additional investigation may be required where it is deemed necessary. b. If required, a scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority, for written approval. The scheme shall account for any comments made by the Local Planning Authority before the development hereby permitted is first occupied. During the course of the development: c. The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues. Before the development is first brought into use: d. The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval. Reason: Contamination is known or suspected on the site due to a former land use. The Local Planning Authority (LPA) therefore wishes to ensure that the development can be implemented and occupied with adequate regard for public and environmental safety in accordance with policy EQ8 Contamination of the adopted Local Plan. Supporting notes: a. An initial phase 1
Condition : 5 - No construction material or skip shall be kept on the footway or carriageway of A4 Great West Road at all times. Reason: In the interests of highway safety

Condition : 6 - Before commencement of the development, a Construction Logistics Plan (CLP) shall be produced in accordance with TfL's CLP guidance and this shall be submitted and approved by the local planning authority prior to construction commencing on site. The plan so approved shall be followed during the course of construction. Reason: In the interest of highway safety and to protect neighbours' living conditions Note: The Council advises the developer to liaise with Transport for London on the content of the plan before submitting to the Council for approval

Condition : 7 - All construction servicing must be undertaken within the boundary of the application site. No construction vehicles shall wait/ load/ unload direct from A4 Great West Road. Reason: In the interests of highway safety

Condition : 8 - Before the filling station hereby approved opens, the amended access and on-site car parking all as shown on the approved drawings shall be completed and made permanently available for use Reason: In the interests of pedestrian and vehicle safety

Condition : 9 - Before the filling station hereby approved opens, details of cycle parking to be provided on site shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority, provided for such use and permanently retained Reason: In the interests of pedestrian and vehicle safety

Condition : 10 - Before the filling station hereby approved opens, details of entry and exit signage to be provided at each access together with Arrows and other signage to be provided to guide drivers within the site shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and installed and retained permanently thereafter Reason: In the interests of pedestrian and vehicle safety

Condition : 11 - The door in the eastern end of the forecourt sales building hereby approved and marked on the approved plans as 'fire escape' shall be fitted with a self-closing mechanism and shall not be kept open except while being used for exit purposes. Reason: To protect neighbours from unacceptable noise and disturbance

Condition : 12 - Before the filling station hereby approved opens, an area of the forecourt alongside No 485 Great West Road 2.4 metres wide and extending the full distance from the Great West Road frontage to the front of the sales building shall be clearly marked up on the surface of the ground as not being available for parking and so maintained permanently. Reason: To protect neighbours from unacceptable noise and disturbance

Condition : 13 - Before the filling station hereby approved opens, the operator shall provide waste disposal bins on the forecourt adjacent to each pump island and either side of the sales entrance building and these shall be retained in place permanently and emptied into the main site waste storage once full. Reason: To protect neighbours' living conditions and the appearance of the area

Condition : 14 - Prior to the occupation of the development hereby approved, a Litter Control Strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Strategy shall be adhered to throughout the lifetime of the development. Reason: To comply with adopted Local Plan policy EQ7 (Sustainable waste management)

Condition : 15 - Before the hereby approved development is occupied, the 1.8 metres fencing between the shop building and the boundary with 485 Great West Road (as shown on the approved drawings 12916-22K) shall be erected and retained thereafter. Reason: To comply with adopted Local Plan policy EC2 (Developing a Sustainable Local Transport Network).

Condition : 16 - With the exception of the use of the night pay window, no other public address or amplified equipment audible beyond the site boundaries shall be used outside the hours of 8 am to 10 pm on any day unless its use is required in the event of an emergency.
Reason: To protect neighbours' living conditions.

Condition : 17 - The noise level emitted during operation of the public address system shall not exceed those specified in the Sharps Redmore Noise Assessment (project ref: 2523405, dated October 2025), namely 39dB LAeqT, with a maximum noise level 48dB LAfmax at the fa�ade of the nearest noise sensitive receptor between the hours of 22:00 to 07:00.  Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise.
description: Variation of condition 16 (public address system) to allow the use of the night window of planning permission P/2017/0890 approved 17/09/2018 for the erection of new sales building including ATM, canopy, replacement pumps, vent stack and fills, A/C refrigeration units, refuse enclosure and associated works and services including alterations to the entrance crossover to Jersey Road following the demolition of the existing sales building.
